_approach: Instead of one element accelerating smoothly, this riser splices two different build vocabularies end to end within two bars — bar 1 is a Jersey-flavoured kick shape thickening with claps, bar 2 abruptly switches to a hardstyle four-on-the-floor kick ramping to the drop — mirroring dariacore's abrupt genre/tempo-feel shifts even inside a single build-up rather than one continuous ramp.
